$comment: The Regex Lab mark: a capture group, (.*).
This file is the single source of truth for the geometry and the palette.
Both readers import it, so the header logo and the favicons cannot drift:
- scripts/generate-assets.mjs renders it to every PNG in public/
- src/components/shared/Logo.tsx renders it inline in the page
Coordinates are in a 160x100 glyph box, not a square one, because `(.*)` is
four characters of roughly equal advance: the mark is wider than it is tall,
and squashing it into a square is what made the previous icon look wrong.
Each tile scales this box to fit and centres it.
The palette is here rather than in tokens.css on purpose. These are brand
colours for a mark that has to read at 16 pixels on an unknown background;
they are artwork, not interface, and they are deliberately not the UI accent
$tiers: Stroke weight, padding and star arm count change with the rendered size.
This is the whole reason the mark survives a 16px favicon.
At 16px the glyph box is about 13px wide, so a dot of radius 8.5 in glyph
units comes out under one pixel across and simply disappears, and a
five-armed asterisk with a 9-unit stroke fuses into a blob. Each tier below
trades fidelity for ink: bigger relative strokes, a larger dot, and at the
smallest sizes a four-armed star, which is still an asterisk but survives
